features.title: Unicorn Theme — Pink & Purple Palette
features.description: Two new variants (light + dark) with amethyst purple and hot pink as primary/secondary colours
features.details:
A vibrant pink-and-purple theme inspired by unicorn aesthetics.

  • unicorn-light — Amethyst purple primary (#9b59b6), hot pink secondary (#e91e90), white surfaces with faint lavender tint (#faf5fc), dark aubergine text (#2d1b3d), light purple borders (#e1bee7)
  • unicorn-dark — Deep purple-black backgrounds (#1a0e24 / #241432), lighter purple primary (#ce93d8) for dark-mode contrast, lighter pink secondary (#f48fb1), muted purple borders (#4a2660), warm lavender-white text (#f3e5f5)

features.title: Dreamy Theme — Beige & Biscuit Palette
features.description: Two new variants (light + dark) with warm brown and dusty taupe as primary/secondary colours
features.details:
A calm, earthy theme built around warm cream, biscuit, and chocolate tones.

  • dreamy-light — Warm brown primary (#8d6e63), dusty rose-brown secondary (#a1887f), warm cream surfaces (#fffdf9 / #f5f0eb), dark chocolate text (#3e2723), light biscuit borders (#d7ccc8)
  • dreamy-dark — Dark espresso backgrounds (#1c1410 / #2a1f1a), lighter taupe primary (#bcaaa4) for dark-mode contrast, warm off-white text (#efebe9), dark brown borders (#4e342e), code background (#1a1210)

enhancements.title: Theme Registration — All 6 Surfaces
enhancements.description: Both new themes registered in AVAILABLE_THEMES, listBases(), build-css.js, theme-roller dropdown, layout variant dots (count 16→20), and kickstart builder
enhancements.details:
All five registration points updated so the new themes are reachable from every surface:

  • src/theme.js — Added 'unicorn-light', 'unicorn-dark', 'dreamy-light', 'dreamy-dark' to AVAILABLE_THEMES; added 'unicorn' and 'dreamy' to listBases()
  • scripts/build-css.js — Added 4 CSS file entries so themes are concatenated into public/dist/themes/domma-themes.css
  • src/theme-roller.js — Added two new <optgroup> blocks to the theme picker dropdown
  • public/layouts/js/layout.js — Added gradient CSS rules for variant dot swatches; added 4 dot buttons; updated tooltip count from 16 to 20
  • public/download/kickstart-builder.js — Added 4 entries to the THEMES array for the Kickstart Builder theme selector
